title: .pattern-config.json
description: Per-repo configuration for the factory-goal-prompts pattern. Lives at the consumer repo root as .pattern-config.json. One schema, two consumers: the plugin's skills and commands read it for paths, partitions, gate commands, and labels; the issue linter (scripts/lint-issue.mjs) reads it for partition and spec-path validation. All paths are relative to the repo root; no leading slash, no '..' segments.

version.description: Config format version. Always 1 for now; consumers reject anything else.

spec_dir.description: Directory holding dated spec files (YYYY-MM-DD-topic.md). Template default: docs/specs. The linter requires spec anchors to resolve under this directory when the config file is present.

known_issues_dir.description: Directory holding known-issue and resolved-bug write-ups. Template default: docs/known-issues.

roadmap_path.description: Path to the roadmap file whose status markers are updated at close-out. Template default: docs/ROADMAP.md.

partitions.description: Coverage partitions / test suites that can own a test plan. When non-empty, the linter requires each issue's test plan section to name one of them.

name.description: Partition name as it appears on a 'Partition/suite:' line (lowercase, digits, hyphens).

description.description: What the partition covers and when it runs.

gate_commands.description: Commands that must be green before a PR merges; kickoff and close-out surfaces cite them by name.

name.description: Short gate name, e.g. test, lint, build.

run.description: The shell command to run from the repo root.

labels.description: The issue label set this repo uses; issue authoring picks labels from this list.
